lane: H82S windowed spectral magnetic source-depth gradient (Spector & Grant 1970 single-slope depth index)
hypothesis: A lateral step in the radial-power-spectrum depth-to-source-ensemble estimate computed from the cached RTP band marks a blind basement-offsetting normal fault, independent of the field's raw amplitude/tilt/Euler behaviour already tested and found negative in this repository.
mimic: Volcanic edifices/calderas with a locally shallow source population but no bounding structural offset; GeoDAWN flight-line tie-spacing aliasing at the block's Nyquist scale.
inputs: data/bridge/existing_faults.tif and sample_submission.tif for grid/footprint/catalogue only
signature: 32x32 px (3.2 km) non-overlapping Hann-tapered blocks; 2D FFT; azimuthally averaged radial power spectrum; linear fit of ln(amplitude) vs wavenumber over a fixed mid-band (bins 1..8 of 16, DC and top bins excluded); depth = -slope, clipped to [100, 4000] m; bilinear resample to full grid; spatial gradient magnitude is the candidate surface.
physical_units_caveat: A single-slope Spector & Grant style index assumes a random ensemble of sources at a common statistical depth per block; it is not the two-depth Bouligand/Okubo centroid Curie-point-depth method (that is H82S-2, deferred). No claim of calibrated Curie-isotherm depth in degrees C is made.
controls: matched random control at the same emitted-dot budget
validation: Unchanged gems57.holdout.buffered_component_draw (seed 20), gems57.evaluate_holdout (gems57-pooled-hide-v2), paired physical spatial-cluster bootstrap (1000 draws) via pooled_summary. No catalogue-derived features; all visible-fault pixels masked pixel-exactly.
promotion: No weekly slot. Require: both canaries symmetric AUC <= 0.90 (leakage stop), candidate pooled HOLDOUT-DTI exceeds BOTH the matched random control (paired 95% CI excludes 0) AND the retained 0.152718 incumbent (cross-draw reference, not paired -- same caveat as every other H7x/H8x lane in this repo), literal/mutual uniqueness scan, and the shared writer's on-disk validation, before any separate selector step.
registry_policy: Unchanged template literal support > 0 / binary-dot mutual-overlap reading (both reported); stop on a confirmed duplicate witness; partial scan proves rejection only, never uniqueness.
retention: If Exp 1 (canary) or Exp 2 (holdout) is negative, retain exactly the measured surface/holdout numbers as a locally validated research artifact; no additional experiments and no slot are spent beyond the frozen 3-experiment budget for this lane.
expected_improvement: Unknown; hypotheses are ordinal research priorities (see research/h82spec_hypotheses.md), never projected scores.
disclosed_source_check: evidence/h82spec_source_check.json documents the obtainability check for H82S-4/H82S-5, which remain BLOCKED and are not implemented in this lane.
